description: Go CodeLens for workspace and dependency code (references, implementations, implemented interfaces, methods, package imports), plus inline variable values while debugging. / Go 代码的 CodeLens（引用、实现、实现的接口、方法、包导入），覆盖工作区与依赖包；调试时内联显示变量值。
config.title: Go Code Insight
dependencies.enable: Show lenses in Go files outside the workspace (module cache, other repositories, GOROOT).
dependencies.index: Serve lenses in module-cache files from a persistent cross-reference index (built once per module version with the Go toolchain and shared by all windows) instead of a language server.
dependencies.prebuild: Which dependency modules to index ahead of time.
dependencies.prebuild.sameOrg: Dependency modules from the same organization as the workspace module (e.g. github.com/acme/*), in the background after startup.
dependencies.prebuild.all: Every dependency module, in the background after startup.
dependencies.prebuild.off: Only index a module when one of its files is opened.
references.enable: Show reference counts ("N refs") on types, functions and methods.
references.fields: Also show reference counts on struct fields.
implementations.enable: Show implementation counts on interfaces and interface methods.
implements.enable: Show which interfaces a concrete type implements, and which interface method a method implements.
implements.maxNames: Maximum interface names shown inline; the rest is collapsed into "+N".
implements.hideUnexportedForeign: Hide unexported interfaces from other packages (e.g. runtime.stringer).
implements.exclude: Interfaces to hide from "implements" lenses, by qualified name, e.g. ["fmt.Stringer", "error"].
methods.enable: Show "N methods" on non-interface types (counted locally across the package's files).
packageImports.enable: Show "N imports" (files importing the package) on the package clause.
outsideWorkspace.moduleIndex: For Go files from other repositories (or when the dependency index is off), also query a gopls rooted at the file's own module so that references and implementations inside that module are counted. Started on demand, stopped when idle. Not used for the standard library.
outsideWorkspace.idleMinutes: Stop a module gopls after this many idle minutes.
outsideWorkspace.maxServers: Maximum number of module gopls processes running at once (the least recently used one is stopped).
goplsPath: gopls executable used for module gopls processes. Empty: go.alternateTools.gopls, $GOBIN, $GOPATH/bin, ~/go/bin, then PATH.
maxConcurrentRequests: Maximum number of concurrent gopls requests issued by this extension.
refreshDelay: Debounce (ms) before refreshing lenses in other editors after Go code changes.
inlineValues.enable: Show variable and parameter values inline while debugging Go (requires "debug.inlineValues" to be "auto" or "on").
inlineValues.maxLength: Maximum length of an inline value. Longer scalar values are truncated; longer structs, slices and maps are hidden.
